{{Quote|Arise, Dread Guard! Protect your Masters!|Draxus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Draxus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Dread Host]], the armies of the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Dread War]] on [[Oricon]], Draxus was the [[Gate Commander]] of the [[Dread Fortress]], commanding the Dread Host forces that defended the fortress' main gate. Draxus was [[Death/Legends|slain]] along with many of the defenders in the final assault on the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gate Commander Draxus appears as the second boss in the Operation "The Dread Fortress," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.4.<ref name="TOR" />
